title: Vision
Pitch: Press one button after a glass of water; in the evening see how many glasses there were today, without keeping the number in your head. ^VIS-2
Problem: People lose count of the glasses of water they drank by evening. ^VIS-3
Who: One role: a person who tracks how much water they drank today, with one press per glass and the count always in sight. ^VIS-4
Not doing: No undo and no history of past days. ^VIS-5
